words.gloss: place of sacrifice to the gods
with the Ṛc and Sāman verses

words.gram: m. nom. pl. pres. part. sam-√tṝ

hindi: हम पृथिवी के इस देवयजन स्थान पर आ गए हैं, जहाँ सब देवता प्रसन्न हुए थे; ऋक् और साम के साथ पार होते हुए, यजुओं के साथ, धन की वृद्धि और अन्न से हम आनन्दित हों। ये दिव्य जल मेरे लिए कल्याणकारी हों। हे ओषधि, रक्षा करो; हे स्वधिति, इसे हिंसित मत करो।
english: We have come here to this place of sacrifice to the gods on the earth, where all the gods took pleasure; crossing over with the Ṛc and Sāman verses and with the yajus formulas, may we rejoice with increase of wealth and refreshment. May these divine waters be wholesome for me. O herb, protect; O blade, do not harm him.
notes: 'devī roṣadhe' = devīḥ oṣadhe (the r of devīr is written with the next word). svadhiti rendered literally as 'blade'; the printed text does not say what it is. 'enam' left as 'him/this' (referent not given).

hindi: जल, जो माताएँ हैं, हमें शुद्ध करें; घृत को पवित्र करने वाली (देवियाँ) हमें घृत से पवित्र करें। क्योंकि ये दिव्य (जल) सारी अशुद्धि बहा ले जाते हैं; इनमें से मैं शुद्ध और पवित्र होकर निकलता हूँ। तू दीक्षा और तप का शरीर है; उस कल्याणकारी और सुखद तुझको मैं धारण करता हूँ, शुभ वर्ण को पुष्ट करता हुआ।
english: May the waters, the mothers, purify us; may the purifiers of ghee cleanse us with ghee. For the divine ones carry away all impurity; out of these I come, pure and cleansed. You are the body of dīkṣā and tapas; that kindly, helpful one I put on, nourishing a good colour.

text_flags.why: j for ṃ (stray Latin letter in the Devanagari too); the sense needs the neuter accusative viśvam 'all'

notes: ud ... ā ... emi read together ('I come up out of these'; tmesis); ābhyaḥ 'from these (waters)'. ghṛtapvaḥ taken as 'ghee-purifiers' (adjective of the waters). 'pari dadhe' translated 'I put on' (literally 'I put around').

hindi: तू महतियों का दूध है; तू तेज देने वाला है, मुझे तेज दे। तू वृत्र की पुतली है; तू दृष्टि देने वाला है, मुझे दृष्टि दे।
english: You are the milk of the great ones; you are the giver of splendour: give me splendour. You are the pupil of Vṛtra; you are the giver of sight: give me sight.
notes: mahīnām (f. gen. pl. 'of the great ones') has no noun in the line; the text does not say what is meant. Vṛtra kept as a name.

words.gloss: of the one purified by the strainer

hindi: चित्त का स्वामी मुझे पवित्र करे, वाणी का स्वामी मुझे पवित्र करे; देव सविता मुझे अखण्डित छन्ने से, सूर्य की किरणों से पवित्र करे। हे छन्ने के स्वामी, छन्ने से पवित्र हुए उस तेरे (प्रसंग में), मैं जिस कामना से पवित्र करता हूँ, उसे मैं सिद्ध कर सकूँ।
english: May the lord of thought purify me; may the lord of speech purify me; may the god Savitṛ purify me with the unbroken strainer, with the rays of the sun. O lord of the strainer, of you who are purified by the strainer: with whatever desire I purify, may I be able to achieve that.
notes: 'pune' has no stated object; 'tat śakeyam' rendered 'may I be able to achieve that' (the verb śak is used with an implied accusative or infinitive). 'cit' rendered 'thought'; alternative 'mind/consciousness'.

hindi: हे देवो, हम तुमसे उस अनुष्ठान में चलते हुए यज्ञ में वांछित धन माँगते हैं। हे यज्ञ के योग्य देवो, हम तुम्हें आशीर्वादों के लिए बुलाते हैं।
english: O gods, we ask of you what is precious, at the sacrifice now proceeding. O gods worthy of sacrifice, we call on you for blessings.
notes: The verb īmahe is taken as 'we ask/beg' (ā-īmahe); the exact root is uncertain. 'prayati adhvare' read as locative absolute-like 'at the sacrifice that is going forward'. 'āśiṣaḥ' taken as the object of the second 'we call (for)'; alternative: 'we call you, the blessings'.

hindi: स्वाहा! मन से यज्ञ को (मैं आरम्भ करता हूँ); स्वाहा! विशाल अन्तरिक्ष से; स्वाहा! द्युलोक और पृथिवी से; स्वाहा! वायु से मैं ग्रहण करता हूँ; स्वाहा!
english: Hail! The sacrifice from the mind; hail! from the wide mid-region; hail! from heaven and earth; hail! from the wind I take it up; hail!

text_flags.why: j for ṃ (stray Latin letter in the Devanagari too); the ablative dual ends in -bhyām

notes: 'svāhā uroḥ antarikṣāt svāhā' fused in one token. 'ārabhe' is taken as governing 'yajñam' and each ablative ('I take up the sacrifice from the mind ... from the wind'); the sentence has no other verb.

hindi: आकूति को, प्रयोग (प्रयुज्) को, अग्नि को स्वाहा; मेधा को, मन को, अग्नि को स्वाहा; दीक्षा को, तप को, अग्नि को स्वाहा; सरस्वती को, पूषा को, अग्नि को स्वाहा। हे दिव्य, विशाल, सबका कल्याण करने वाले जलो, हे द्यावापृथिवी, हे विशाल अन्तरिक्ष, हम बृहस्पति की हवि से सेवा करें। स्वाहा!
english: Hail to Intention, to the Yoker, to Agni! Hail to Insight, to Mind, to Agni! Hail to Dīkṣā, to Tapas, to Agni! Hail to Sarasvatī, to Pūṣan, to Agni! O divine waters, great and all-beneficent, O heaven and earth, O wide mid-region, may we serve Bṛhaspati with the oblation. Hail!
notes: 'prayuje' is obscure ('the yoker/application'); the line does not say what is meant. 'uro' (before antarikṣa) is taken as a vocative form of uru 'wide' (alternatively a different word); the vocative list is read as addressed to the waters, heaven-and-earth and mid-region, with 'vidhema' governing bṛhaspataye haviṣā. Token '|āpo' keeps the daṇḍa attached to the word.

hindi: प्रत्येक मनुष्य नेता देव की मित्रता का वरण करे; प्रत्येक जन धनों की याचना करता है और पुष्टि के लिए तेज का वरण करता है। स्वाहा!
english: May every mortal choose the friendship of the leading god; everyone seeks riches and chooses splendour, for thriving. Hail!
notes: Lines 1 and 2 follow the familiar Ṛgvedic wording; 'iṣudhyati' taken as 'implores/seeks'; 'puṣyase' as a dative infinitive 'for thriving' (alternatively 'to thrive'). 'netuḥ' could also be read as a separate noun phrase 'of the god, the leader'.

words.gloss: two crafts, two works of art

hindi: तुम दोनों ऋक् और साम की शिल्प-कृतियाँ हो; उन तुम दोनों को मैं ग्रहण करता हूँ; वे तुम दोनों इस यज्ञ की समाप्ति तक मेरी रक्षा करो। तू शरण है, मुझे शरण दे; तुझे नमस्कार हो; मुझे हिंसित मत कर।
english: You two are the works of art of the Ṛc and the Sāman. I take hold of you two; protect me, you two, up to the close of this sacrifice. You are protection; give me protection. Homage to you; do not harm me.
notes: 'ṛksāmayoḥ' as genitive dual. 'te vām ārabhe' read as 'those two, you two, I take hold of'; the repeated 'te' is obscure. 'ā asya yajñasya udṛcaḥ' read as 'up to the close (udṛc) of this sacrifice'; 'udṛc' is uncertain (end, close). 'sthaste' = sthaḥ te.

hindi: तू शक्ति है, आङ्गिरसी है, ऊन के समान कोमल है; मुझमें बल स्थापित कर। तू सोम का आवरण है; तू विष्णु का शरण है, यजमान का शरण है; तू इन्द्र की योनि है; खेतों को उत्तम अन्न वाला बना। हे वनस्पति, ऊपर उठ; सीधे खड़े होकर इस यज्ञ की समाप्ति तक मुझे कष्ट से बचा।
english: You are strength, belonging to Aṅgiras, soft as wool: place strength in me. You are the wrapper of Soma; you are Viṣṇu's shelter, the sacrificer's shelter; you are the womb of Indra; make the ploughed lands rich in good grain. Rise up, O lord of the forest; standing upright, protect me from distress up to the close of this sacrifice.

text_flags.why: possible: ṛ dropped; the parallel in unit 9 reads yajñasyodṛcaḥ

notes: 'ūrk asi āṅgirasī ūrṇamradāḥ' fused in one token. 'nīvi' rendered 'wrapper' (literally a girdle or covering). 'vanaspate' (lord of the forest) is left as a plain address. 'ā asya yajñasya udṛcaḥ' as in unit 9. The three lines are three formulas of one numbered unit (line 1 and lines 2-3 may be separate formulas); grouping kept.

hindi: व्रत का पालन करो: अग्नि ब्रह्मा है, अग्नि यज्ञ है, यज्ञ के योग्य वनस्पति है। हम अपने अभीष्ट के लिए उस दिव्य, अत्यन्त कृपालु, तेज देने वाली और यज्ञ को वहन करने वाली बुद्धि (प्रार्थना) का स्मरण करते हैं; वह हमारे वश में और सुगम हो। जो देवता मन से उत्पन्न हैं, मन से जुड़े हैं और दक्ष संकल्प वाले हैं, वे हमारी सहायता करें, वे हमारी रक्षा करें; उनके लिए स्वाहा!
english: Perform the observance: Agni is the Brahman priest, Agni is the sacrifice, the lord of the forest is worthy of sacrifice. For our aim we call to mind the divine thought, very gracious, the giver of splendour, the carrier of the sacrifice; may she be of good access and in our power. The gods who are born of the mind, yoked by the mind, of skilful power: may they help us, may they protect us. Hail to them!
notes: 'brahmā' taken as the Brahman priest (alternatively brahma, n., 'sacred power'). 'sutīrthā' rendered 'with good access' (literally 'having good fords'); 'dhiyam' is feminine and the following adjectives agree with it. 'manāmahe' (we think of / call to mind) is the Vedic present.

hindi: हे जलो, पीए जाने पर तुम हमारे उदर के भीतर स्फूर्तिदायक और अत्यन्त सुखकर होओ। वे दिव्य, अमर, ऋत को बढ़ाने वाली (जलदेवियाँ) हमारे लिए रोग-रहित, पीड़ा-रहित और निर्दोष होकर प्रिय लगें।
english: Once drunk, O waters, be quickening and very kind within our belly. May they, the divine, immortal waters that increase the order (ṛta), be pleasing to us, free from wasting sickness, free from illness, faultless.
notes: 'śvātrāḥ' rendered 'quickening' (alternatives: swift, refreshing). 'svadantu' 'let them be pleasing/sweet'. 'ayakṣmā' glossed as 'free from wasting sickness' (yakṣma kept literal).

hindi: यह तेरा यज्ञीय शरीर है; मैं जलों को छोड़ता हूँ, सन्तान को नहीं। हे कष्ट से मुक्त करने वाले, स्वाहा से अर्पित (जलो), पृथिवी में प्रवेश करो। पृथिवी के साथ एक हो जा।
english: This is your sacrificial body; I release the waters, not the offspring. You who free from distress, offered with svāhā, enter the earth. Unite with the earth.

text_flags.why: possible: j for ṃ (as in units 2, 6, 24; the Devanagari also has Latin j); the compound aṃhomuc 'freeing from distress' fits the sense

notes: The referent of 'te' and the object 'apaḥ' are not stated; 'apo muñcāmi na prajām' kept literal ('I release the waters, not offspring'). Line 2 'pṛthivyā sambhava' may be a separate formula; grouping kept as printed.

hindi: हे अग्नि, तू भली-भाँति जागता रह; हम भली-भाँति आनन्दित हों। सावधान रहते हुए हमारी रक्षा कर; जागने पर हमें फिर से (स्वस्थ/पूर्ण) कर।
english: O Agni, stay well awake; may we rejoice well. Protect us, not neglecting us; at our waking make us whole again.
notes: 'rakṣā ṇo' = rakṣa naḥ. 'apra-yucchan' (not neglecting, vigilant) is a Vedic participle; sense taken from the usual reading. 'punaskṛdhi' (punaḥ kṛdhi) rendered 'make (us) again', with 'whole' supplied only as the natural sense (not in the text); alternative: 'renew us'.

hindi: मेरे पास फिर से मन आ गया है, फिर से आयु आ गई है, फिर से प्राण, फिर से आत्मा आ गई है, फिर से दृष्टि, फिर से श्रवण-शक्ति आ गई है। अहिंसित, शरीर के रक्षक वैश्वानर अग्नि हमें दुर्गति से और निन्दा से बचाएँ।
english: Again the mind has come to me; again life has come to me; again the breath, again the self has come to me; again sight, again hearing has come to me. May Agni Vaiśvānara, unharmed, the guardian of the body, protect us from misfortune and from blame.
notes: Wording of line 1 is repetitive; 'ma' in the printed text is me before the vowel of ā (me + ā). 'agan' is the aorist (injunctive) of √gam, rendered 'has come'. 'duritāt' = from evil/misfortune; 'avadyāt' = from blame/disgrace.

hindi: हे अग्नि, तू व्रतों का रक्षक देव है, मनुष्यों के बीच। तू यज्ञों में स्तुति के योग्य है। हे सोम, इतना दे, और अधिक ला। हमारा देव सविता धन का दाता है; वह धन दे।
english: O Agni, you are the guardian of observances, a god among mortals; you are to be praised at the sacrifices. Give this much, O Soma; bring more. May the god Savitṛ, the giver of wealth, give us wealth.

text_flags.why: possible: final ā of somā unexplained (vocative soma expected); read as a lengthened vocative

notes: Reading of 'rāsveyat somā bhūyo bhara' is uncertain (the vocative Soma after a verse to Agni; 'ā bhara' is an alternative division). 'ā ... martyeṣu ā' is a doubled 'ā' (martyeṣvā, with a preceding 'ā'), taken as 'among'. 'vasvadāt' = vasu adāt. 'naḥ' in 'devo naḥ savitā' taken as genitive 'our'.

hindi: हे शुक्र (दीप्तिमान्), यह तेरा शरीर है, यह तेज है; उसके साथ एक हो, दीप्ति को प्राप्त कर। तू वेगवती है, मन से धारण की गई है, विष्णु के लिए प्रिय/स्वीकृत है।
english: This is your body, O bright one; this is splendour; unite with that, go to radiance. You are swift, held by the mind, pleasing to Viṣṇu.
notes: 'jūḥ' (swift/impelling) is uncertain; 'juṣṭā viṣṇave' rendered 'pleasing to Viṣṇu' (alternative: 'offered/accepted for Viṣṇu'). 'śukra' is treated as a vocative epithet (could also be the proper name of the Śukra draught).

hindi: उस सत्य-प्रेरणा वाली तेरी प्रेरणा में मैं तेरे शरीर के नियन्त्रण को प्राप्त करूँ। स्वाहा! तू शुक्र (उज्ज्वल) है, चन्द्र (दीप्तिमान्) है, अमृत है, सब देवों से सम्बद्ध है।
english: Of that one, of you whose impulse is true: in the impulse, may I obtain the control of your body. Hail! You are bright; you are shining; you are immortal; you belong to all the gods.
notes: The first sentence is compressed and its exact grammar is uncertain ('tasyāḥ te satyasavasaḥ prasave tanvo yantram aśīya'); rendered literally. Token '|' is the daṇḍa and is a separate token here.

words.gloss: with a head at both ends

hindi: तू चित् है, मना है, धी है, दक्षिणा है, क्षत्रिया है, यज्ञ के योग्य है, अदिति है, दोनों ओर शिर वाली है। वह तू हमारे लिए आगे और पीछे भली-भाँति मुख वाली हो। मित्र तुझे पैर से बाँधे; पूषा मार्ग की रक्षा करे; अध्यक्ष इन्द्र के लिए।
english: You are thought, you are mind, you are insight, you are the skilful one, you are of the ruling power, worthy of sacrifice; you are Aditi, with a head at both ends. As such, be well facing forward and well facing back for us. Let Mitra bind you by the foot; let Pūṣan guard the road; for Indra the overseer.
notes: Line 1 is a litany of 'you are' predicates; 'dakṣiṇā' and 'manā' are uncertain in sense (dakṣiṇā could be the sacrificial fee). Last clause 'pūṣādhvanaspātv indrāyādhyakṣāya' is compressed; rendered literally with the object ('you') implied; the grammar of 'indrāya adhyakṣāya' is uncertain.

hindi: तेरी माता सहमत हो, पिता सहमत हो, सहोदर भाई सहमत हो, समान यूथ का मित्र सहमत हो। हे देवी, तू इन्द्र के लिए देव सोम की ओर जा। रुद्र तुझे लौटाए; सोम को मित्र बनाकर कुशलपूर्वक फिर लौट आ।
english: Let your mother consent, your father, your brother of the same womb, your friend of the same herd. O goddess, go towards the god, to Soma for Indra. May Rudra turn you back; with Soma as your friend, come back again in well-being.
notes: 'devam acchehi indrāya somam' is read as 'go to the god, (to) Soma, for Indra'; the punctuation of the clauses is uncertain. 'varttayatu' spelled with a doubled t (orthographic variant of vartayatu); not flagged.

hindi: तू धन वाली है, अदिति है, आदित्य-सम्बन्धी है, रुद्र-सम्बन्धी है, दीप्तिमती है। बृहस्पति तुझे अनुग्रह में रमाए; रुद्र वसुओं के साथ (प्रसन्न हुआ है)।
english: You are the wealthy one, you are Aditi, you belong to the Ādityas, you belong to the Rudras, you are shining. May Bṛhaspati delight you in his favour; Rudra, with the Vasus, has taken pleasure.
notes: 'ā cake' is uncertain: 'vasubhir ā cake' is taken as a perfect of an ā-compound ('has taken pleasure / has been pleased'); other possible readings exist, and the subject and tense are not firm. 'ramṇātu' read as 'let him cause to rest/delight'. The pronoun in 'bṛhaspatiṣ ṭvā' is the object 'you'. The Hindi/English closing clause is therefore tentative.

words.gloss: at the place of sacrifice to the gods
wealth (first part of rāyaḥ, split by a stray space)

hindi: अदिति के शिर पर, पृथिवी के देवयजन स्थान में मैं तुझे सींचता हूँ; तू इडा का स्थान है, घृत से भरा हुआ; स्वाहा! हम में रमण कर, हम में तेरा बन्धुत्व है; तुझ में धन है, मेरा धन है; हम धन की वृद्धि से अलग न हों; तब धन।
english: On the head of Aditi, at the place of sacrifice to the gods on the earth, I sprinkle you; you are the place of Iḍā, rich in ghee; hail! Take delight in us; in us is your kinship; in you is wealth, mine is wealth; may we not be parted from increase of wealth; then wealth.

text_flags.why: possible: the long ā before si looks like a typo for padam asi
possible: wrongly split token; the sense needs rāyaḥ here (rāyo), cf. 'me rāyo' next
possible: toto is not a Sanskrit word; suggested tato 'then' or tvotā 'protected by you'

notes: Line 2 is difficult: the printed tokens 'tve rā yo me rāyo mā vayaṃ' look damaged or wrongly spaced; 'viyaṷṣma' = viyauṣma (aorist optative of vi-√yu, 'may we be parted'). The closing 'toto rāyaḥ' is unclear. Translation is tentative; ritual sense not imported.

words.gloss: I have looked, have been joined (uncertain)

hindi: मैं दिव्य बुद्धि के साथ, उदार और विशाल दृष्टि वाली (देवी) के साथ संयुक्त/दृष्ट हुआ हूँ। मेरी आयु का हरण मत कर; और मैं तेरी (आयु का) न करूँ। हे देवी, तेरे दर्शन में मैं वीर (पुत्र) को प्राप्त करूँ।
english: I have been joined (or have looked) with the divine insight, with the generous, wide-seeing one. Do not steal my life, nor I yours. May I find a hero in your sight, O goddess.
notes: The first verb 'samakhye' and its construction are uncertain (sam-akhye: 'I have looked / been seen / been joined'). 'mo aham tava' read as 'nor I (steal) yours', with 'āyuḥ' understood; this is supplied from context and uncertain. 'vīra' rendered 'hero' (the text does not say 'son').

hindi: 'यह तेरा गायत्र भाग है' ऐसा मेरे लिए सोम से कहो। 'यह तेरा त्रैष्टुभ भाग है' ऐसा मेरे लिए सोम से कहो। 'यह तेरा जागत भाग है' ऐसा मेरे लिए सोम से कहो। 'छन्दों के नाम वालों के साम्राज्य को जा' ऐसा मेरे लिए सोम से कहो। तू हमारा है; तेरा शुक्र (उज्ज्वल) ग्रह लेने योग्य है; विवेकशील जन तुझे छाँटें।
english: 'This is your Gāyatra share': so say to Soma for me. 'This is your Traiṣṭubha share': so say to Soma for me. 'This is your Jāgata share': so say to Soma for me. 'Go to the sovereignty of those named after the metres': so say to Soma for me. You are ours; your bright cup is to be taken; may the discerning ones sift you.

text_flags.why: j for ṃ (stray Latin letter in the Devanagari too); genitive plural expected

notes: 'me somāya' is ambiguous (for me / on my behalf). 'brūtāt' is the Vedic -tāt imperative. 'chandonāmānām' rendered 'of those named after metres'. 'śukra grahya' left as 'bright cup'; 'vicitaḥ' (discerning ones) uncertain.

hindi: उस देव सविता की मैं स्तुति करता हूँ, जो द्यावापृथिवी का है, कवि-सदृश प्रज्ञा वाला, सत्य-प्रेरणा वाला, रत्न देने वाला है; (उस) प्रिय, मनन-योग्य, कवि की। जिसकी ऊँची दीप्ति ने प्रेरणा में प्रकाश किया; स्वर्ण-हस्त, सुकर्मा ने कृपा से स्वर्लोक को नापा। प्रजाओं के लिए तुझे; प्रजाएँ तेरे पीछे साँस लें; तू प्रजाओं के पीछे साँस ले।
english: I praise that god Savitṛ of the two (heaven and earth), poet-willed, of true impulse, bestower of treasure; the dear thought, the poet. His lofty splendour, his light, shone in the impulse; the golden-handed, of good skill, measured out heaven by his grace. For the creatures (I take) you; let the creatures breathe after you; you breathe after the creatures.
notes: 'oṇyoḥ' is obscure (traditionally 'of the two, i.e. heaven and earth'); 'kavikratum' and 'ratnadhām' follow the familiar Ṛgvedic wording; 'kṛpā' ambiguous (grace / form). 'amimīta' read as 'measured out'. The last sentence is a separate formula; the object 'tvā' stays implied ('I take you').

hindi: मैं तुझ शुक्र (उज्ज्वल) को शुक्र से खरीदता हूँ, चन्द्र (दीप्तिमान्) को चन्द्र से, अमृत को अमृत से। (सग्मे) तेरी गौ, हममें तेरे दीप्तिमान् (पदार्थ)। तू तप का शरीर है, प्रजापति का वर्ण है; सर्वोच्च (मूल्य) से तू खरीदा जाता है। मैं सहस्र-गुण पोषण से पुष्ट होऊँ।
english: I buy you, the bright one, with the bright; the shining with the shining; the immortal with the immortal. In ... your cow; in us your shining things. You are the body of tapas, the colour of Prajāpati; you are bought with the highest. May I thrive in a thousandfold increase.

text_flags.why: possible: a word (paśunā 'with an animal') seems omitted after parameṇa, where the printed text also has a double space

notes: 'sagme' is obscure (a locative of an unclear word; the translation leaves it as '...'). 'candra' rendered 'shining' (could also be 'gold'). The missing word after parameṇa is suspected from parallel readings of the formula; not applied.

hindi: हे मित्र, हमारे पास आ, उत्तम मैत्री स्थापित करने वाले; इन्द्र के विशाल दक्षिण (भाग) में प्रवेश कर — चाहने वाले की ओर चाहते हुए, सुखद (की ओर) सुखद होकर। हे स्वान, भ्राज, अङ्घारि, बम्भारि, हस्त, सुहस्त, कृशानु, ये तुम्हारे सोम-क्रयण (से सम्बद्ध) हैं; उनकी रक्षा करो; वे तुम्हें हानि न पहुँचाएँ।
english: Mitra, come to us, establisher of good friendship; enter the wide right side of Indra, desiring towards the desiring, agreeable towards the agreeable. O Svāna, Bhrāja, Aṅghāri, Bambhāri, Hasta, Suhasta, Kṛśānu: these are your Soma-purchase (things); guard them; let none harm you.
notes: The sentence 'indrasyorum ā viśa dakṣiṇam' is read as 'enter the wide right (side) of Indra'; 'dakṣiṇam' could instead belong to the following words. The seven names are listed as vocatives; the text itself does not say what they are. 'mā vo dabhan' lacks an expressed subject.

hindi: हे अग्नि, मुझे दुराचरण से दूर कर, सदाचरण में मुझे भागी बना। आयु के साथ, उत्तम आयु के साथ मैं ऊपर उठा हूँ, अमरों के पीछे।
english: Drive me away from ill conduct, O Agni; assign me to good conduct. With life, with good life, I have risen up, after the immortals.
notes: In the printed 'amṛtā~2 anu' the '~2' marks prolongation in the source (pluta); word read as amṛtān (acc. pl.), with the nasal not shown. 'pari ... bādhasva' read as 'drive away from' (tmesis).

hindi: हमने कल्याण की ओर ले जाने वाले, निर्दोष (निर्विघ्न) मार्ग पर पैर रखा है, जिससे मनुष्य सब शत्रुओं से बचता है और धन पाता है।
english: We have stepped onto the path that leads to well-being and is free from harm, by which one avoids all enemies and finds wealth.
notes: 'vṛṇakti' (3 sg.) and 'vindate' have no expressed subject ('one'). 'anehasam' = free from harm / safe.

hindi: तू अदिति की त्वचा है; अदिति के आसन पर बैठ। वृषभ ने द्युलोक को थामा, अन्तरिक्ष को नापा, पृथिवी का विस्तार (नापा)। सम्राट् सब भुवनों पर बैठ गया; वे सब वरुण के व्रत (नियम) हैं।
english: You are the skin of Aditi; sit upon the seat of Aditi. The bull propped up heaven, measured out the mid-region and the breadth of the earth. The universal ruler sat down upon all the worlds; all those are indeed Varuṇa's ordinances.
notes: 'adityai' (printed 'adityai', dative form) is taken as a genitive/dative 'of/for Aditi' with sadaḥ ('seat for Aditi'); both readings are close. 'viśvettāni' = viśvā it tāni. 'varimāṇam pṛthivyāḥ' read as 'the breadth of the earth', object of 'amimīta'. The subject of the second line (samrāṭ) is the one who sat down.

hindi: वरुण ने वनों के ऊपर अन्तरिक्ष को फैलाया, घोड़ों में बल, गौओं में दूध, हृदयों में संकल्प, जनों में अग्नि, आकाश में सूर्य और पर्वत पर सोम को स्थापित किया।
english: Varuṇa stretched out the mid-region over the forests; he placed vigour in the horses, milk in the cows, will in the hearts, fire among the peoples, the sun in the sky, Soma on the rock.
notes: 'vikṣu' taken as 'among the peoples/settlements' (alternatively 'in the waters'); 'adrau' is a locative of adri 'rock, stone, pressing stone'. 'kratum' rendered 'will'.

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. mid. √bhrāj

hindi: सूर्य के नेत्र पर चढ़ो, अग्नि के नेत्र की पुतली पर, जहाँ तुम चमकते हुए, विद्वान् (प्रेरित) के साथ घोड़ों से चलते हो।
english: Ascend the eye of the sun, the pupil of the eye of Agni, where you move, shining, with the bay horses, with the inspired one.

text_flags.why: possible: traśebhi for taśebhi (etaśa 'horse'); the printed form is not a known word

notes: 'etaśebhiḥ' is taken as 'with the (sun's) bay horses'; 'vipaścitā' as 'with the inspired/wise one', and the syntax of 'vipaścitā' (inst. sg.) with 'bhrājamānaḥ' is loose. Addressee not named.

hindi: हे दोनों बैलो, आओ; जुए को वहन करने वाले, जोते जाओ; अश्रु-रहित, वीरों का वध न करने वाले, ब्रह्म (मन्त्र) को प्रेरित करने वाले; यजमान के घरों को कुशलपूर्वक जाओ।
english: O two oxen, come; bearing the yoke, be yoked, tearless, not slaying men, urging on the sacred word; go in well-being to the houses of the sacrificer.
notes: 'usrā' is taken as 'ox/bull' (Vedic usra: bull or cow); 'brahmacodanau' rendered 'urging the sacred word' (brahma could also be 'prayer, sacred power').

hindi: तू मेरे लिए कल्याणकारी है; हे भुवस्पति, सब स्थानों की ओर आगे बढ़। तुझे घात लगाने वाले न पाएँ, तुझे मार्ग के लुटेरे न पाएँ, तुझे हानि चाहने वाले भेड़िये न पाएँ। बाज बनकर दूर उड़; यजमान के घरों को जा; वह हम दोनों के लिए सिद्ध किया हुआ है।
english: You are auspicious to me. Go forth, O lord of the world, over all places. Let not the waylayers find you; let not the highwaymen find you; let not the wolves bent on harm find you. Having become a falcon, fly away; go to the houses of the sacrificer; that is prepared for us two.

text_flags.why: possible: anusvāra missing; 'sam-kṛta' expected (cf. the usual form saṃskṛta)

notes: 'tan nau saṃskṛtam' is obscure ('that is prepared / arranged for us two'). 'paripariṇaḥ' rendered 'waylayers' (literally those who go around). The addressee is not named.

words.gram: m. dat. sg. (Vedic form for mahe)

hindi: मित्र और वरुण के नेत्र को, महान् देव को नमस्कार; उस ऋत की सेवा करो। दूर तक देखने वाले, देवों से उत्पन्न, केतु (ध्वजा), द्यौ के पुत्र सूर्य की स्तुति करो।
english: Homage to the eye of Mitra and Varuṇa, to the great god; honour that order. To the far-seeing, god-born banner, the son of heaven, to the Sun, recite praise.
notes: 'maho' is unclear (read as a dative 'great', agreeing with devāya); 'ṛtam' is rendered 'order' (alternatively 'truth' or 'rite'). 'ketave' is rendered 'banner' (could also be 'beacon, ray').

words.gloss: the two that let loose the prop (obscure)

hindi: तू वरुण का आधार है; तुम दोनों वरुण के स्कम्भ-सर्जनी (खम्भे को छोड़ने/गढ़ने वाली) हो; तू वरुण की ऋत-सदनी है; तू वरुण का ऋत-सदन है। वरुण के ऋत-सदन में बैठ।
english: You are the support of Varuṇa; you two are Varuṇa's skambhasarjanī; you are Varuṇa's seat of order; you are Varuṇa's seat of order. Sit down in Varuṇa's seat of order.
notes: 'skambhasarjanī' is obscure (literally 'prop-releasers' or 'prop-makers'); left untranslated in English and Hindi on purpose. 'stho' = sthaḥ, 2 du. 'ṛtasadanī'/'ṛtasadanam' are parallel forms meaning 'seat of order'. Two lines of one numbered unit; grouping kept.

hindi: तेरे जिन धामों को लोग हवि से पूजते हैं, तेरे उन सबको घेरने वाला तू यज्ञ को (घेरने वाला) हो। घर को बढ़ाने वाला, पार लगाने वाला, उत्तम वीरों वाला, वीरों का वध न करने वाला होकर, हे सोम, घरों की ओर चल।
english: Those abodes of yours which they worship with oblation: may you, encompassing all those of yours, encompass the sacrifice. Increasing the household, bringing safe passage, rich in heroes, not slaying heroes, go forth, O Soma, to the houses.

text_flags.why: possible: sf (with nukta फ़ in the Devanagari) for sph; gayasphāna 'increasing wealth/household'

notes: 'tā te viśvā paribhūr astu yajñam' is ambiguous: read as 'may (you) encompass all those of yours, and the sacrifice'; the construction is compressed. 'gayasphānaḥ' rendered 'increasing the household' (gaya = household/property).
